tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal kyai rdo rje'i sgrub thabs gong ma'i gsung gi rjes 'brang bzhugs/

bi rū pa'i lugs/ oṃ swā sti/ dpal kyai rdo rje'i sgrub thabs gong ma'i gsung gi rjes 'brang zhes bya ba/ bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dgyes pa rdo rje he ru ka /rje btsun de la gus btud nas/ /sgrub thabs mdor bsdus zab mo ni/ /gzhan 'ga' rjes su bzung phyir bshad/ /de la 'dir rnal 'byor dbang phyug bi rū pa'i lam bskor du grags pa dang 'brel ba'i dbang du byas nas/ re zhig yan lag drug pa'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya ba la/ mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor la gnyis/ bskyed pa'i rim pa dang*/ rdzogs pa'i rims pa'o/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa gnyis/ sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag /rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ / zhes pa ci rigs par brjod/ mjug tu/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ / zhes lan gsum bya/ de nas/ rang gi spyi bor padma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/

hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka sku mdog dkar po/ zhal gcig pa phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas hūṃ las thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ shrī badzra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ he ru ka twe no pa tiṣṭha/ ḍi ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ su po ṣyo me bha wa/ sarba siddhi me pra yatstsha/ sarba karmā su tsa me/ tsittaṃ shre yaṃḥku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wan badzra he ru ka /mā me muñtsa/ he ru ko bha wa mahā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūṃ phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzlas la thal mo snying khar sbyar te/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyobs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ de nas/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu nas/ spyi bo nas rang la thim/ rang skad cig gis kyai rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs kar paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/

sems gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bral ba'i ngo bo hūṃ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pas gtso bo'i dbu la brgyan pa/ oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bhyaḥ na maḥshrī he badzra maṇḍal bhyaḥ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod/ /ro langs ma ni chu lag ma/ /ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin cing*/ /pukka sī ni rdo rje'i lag/ de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin/ /gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung*/ /'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod/ /'dod chags chen pos rjes chags pa/ /g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ / ces brjod do/ /de nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*/ / sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ / sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog / zhes lan gsum brjod/ de nas/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yi/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ / tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*/ /dge ba'i chos ni bsdud pa dang*/ /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/

/sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas brtan por gzung*/ /rdo rje rig mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /padma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung*/ / las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med mchog /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun kyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*/ /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis sgrol/ /dbugs ma phyung rnams dbugs dbyung zhing*/ /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ / ces lan gsum brjod do/ /de nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig / bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o/ /de nas ye shes kyi tshogs bsag pa ni/ stong pa nyid bsgoms nas sngags 'dis byin gyis brlab par bya ste/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas bsrung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje ra bcu gnyis pa/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ lte ba mthing nag la hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ hūṃ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/

khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar bas gang bar gyur/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum/ bsrung 'khor dngos ni de tsam gyis chog la/ rgyas par spro ba'am zlog pa byed dgos na 'di ltar bya ste/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar paṃ las padma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du/ bhruṃ ser po las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa/ rtse mo rno ba khog pa stong pa/ yangs shing rgya che ba/ go skabs med par gyur/ oṃ badzra tsakra rakṣa hūṃ bhruṃ hūṃ/ lan gsum/ 'khor lo'i nang gi dbus dang*/ phyogs bcur padma dang*/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re/ dbus kyi nyi ma'i steng du bhruṃ ser po/ phyogs bcu'i nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ re re/ de yang lho'i dkar po/ nub kyi dmar po/ gzhan thams cad sngon po/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su rang nyid gtsug gtor 'khor los sgyur ba ser po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ shar du gshin rje mthar byed nag po tho ba 'dzin pa/ lhor shes rab mthar byed dkar po be con 'dzin pa/ nub tu padma mthar byed dmar po padma 'dzin pa/ byang du bgegs mthar byed sngo sangs rdo rje 'dzin pa/ byang shar du mi g.yo ba sngo skya ral gri 'dzin pa/ shar lhor 'dod pa'i rgyal po sngon po lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu dbyug sngon can sngon po dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ nub byang du stobs po che dud nag rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ steng du hūṃ mdzad sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu rang gi phyag rgyas thugs kar 'dzin pa/ 'og tu gnod mdzes mthing nag gtun shing bsnams pa/ hūṃ mdzad ma yin pa gzhan thams cad phyag g.yas pas rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pas thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ phyogs bzhi'i khro bo rnams ni cher khros pa ste/ sku sbom zhing thung ba/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs dang*/

sbrul gyis brgyan pa'o// gzhan rnams ni rol pa'i khro bo ste/ cung zad 'dzum pa/ sku 'khrang zhing grim pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ thams cad kyang spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyi bzhugs pa'o/ /dpral bar oṃ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ de las 'od 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas khro bo bcu gcig bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa la ye shes kyi khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badzra ni ri te hūṃ khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badzra nai wi te hūṃ khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni swāhā/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ khaṃ raṃ mahā arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe nas shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par bstim/ yang 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badzra bha wa a bhiñtsa hūṃ/ bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gshin rje mthar byed la rnam par snang mdzad/ padma mthar byed la 'od dpag med/ gzhan thams cad la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ na maḥs manta buddha nāṃ/ na maḥs manta dharmā ṇāṃ/ na maḥs manta saṃ ghā nāṃ/ oṃ si tā ta pa tre/ oṃ bi ma la/ oṃ shaṃ ka ra/ oṃ pra dyaṃ gī ra/ badzra uṣṇi ṣa tsakra brti sarba yant+ra man tra mū la karma bandhā nāṃ/ tā ḍa naṃ/ kī la nāṃ bā/ ma ma kṛ te/ ye na ke na tsi ta kri taṃ/ tang sarban tu/ tshinda tshinda/ bhinda bhinda/ tsi ri tsi ri/ gi ri gi ri/ ma ra ma ra/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ zhes pa ci rigs pa bzlas so/ /de nas/ su gang dag bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/

gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ bsam pa dang sbyor ba ngan par byed pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad kyi bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /gal te zhi bar ma gyur na/ de'i tshe de dag thams cad kyi lus bcings bar bgyi'o/ /ngag bcing bar bgyi'o/ /yid bcing bar bgyi'o/ /mthu brlag par gyur cig /stobs brlag par gyur cig /rdzu 'phrul brlag par gyur cig /des bzlas pa'i sngags kyis de nyid brlag par gyur cig /des bsgrubs pa'i lha 'dres de'i sha la za bar gyur cig /sbyor ba ngan pa byas pa'i 'bras bu byed pa po de nyid la 'byung bar gyur cig /gnod byed thams cad ni wā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ khro bo 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /dgra bgegs rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /lus ngag thal ba rdul du brlog /rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su sgrol/ /oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la yan lag drug dang ldan pa ste/ de yang*/ e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa/ phyi dkar la nang cung zad dmar ba/ gdengs ka gyen du bstan pa/ de'i nang du/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam sngon po yaṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po raṃ gyi mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po dkar po baṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po laṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du bhruṃ las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa bhruṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng gi bar snang du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥdamar po gnyis kyis mtha' brten pa ni bar do'i rnam par shes pa rnam par dag pa'o/ /'byung bzhi 'khor lo dang bcas pa yang rnam par shes pa de'i snang ba tsam ste/ de rnams ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/

rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin nag po/ ljang khu/ dmar po/ ser po/ dkar po'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser po la dra ba dang phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i steng du rin po che'i za ra tshags dang pu shus brgyan pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol tu 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la/ mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug gis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa/ steng rdo rje'i gdung zlum po dang rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bris shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i steng du rdo rje dang rin po che'i tog gis brgyan pa/ sgo bzhi'i thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta bab bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i steng du/ padma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ gdugs dang ri dwags dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang gos dang*/ 'phan dang*/ me tog gi phreng ba dang*/ zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang*/ rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can la sogs pa/ rgyan du mas brgyan pa'i/ gzhal yas khang du gyur/ de'i phyi rol tu dur khrod chen po brgyad ni/ shar tu gtum drag /lhor 'jigs byed thod pa can/ nub tu 'bar ba'i phreng ba/ byang du tshang tshing 'khrigs pa/ byang shar du drag tu dgod pa/ shar lhor dbang phyug nags tshal/ lho nub tu 'jigs byed mun pa/ nub byang du ki li ki la'i sgra sgrogs pa'o/ /shing gi rtsa ba na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong ba brgyad ni/ shar du brgya byin/ lhor gshin rje/ nub tu chu lha/ byang du gnod sbyin/ byang shar du dbang ldan/ shar lhor me lha/ lho nub tu srin po/ nub byang du rlung lha'o/ /de dag tu ro mgo bo bcad pa dang*/ dpyangs pa dang*/ bsnyal ba dang*/ gsal shing gi phug pa dang*/ mgo bo dang*/ keng rus dang*/ lce spyang dang*/ khwa dang*/ 'ug pa dang*/ bya rgod dang*/

ro langs rnams pheṃ zhes pa'i sgra sgrogs par byed pa/ gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po dang*/ yi dwags dang*/ sha za dang*/ smyo byed dang*/ brjed byed dang*/ mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang*/ gzhan yang zhing skyong ba dang*/ kluu dang*/ sprin dang*/ chu dang*/ me dang*/ mchod rten dang*/ bsgrub pa po rnams dang bcas pa'i dur khrod kyis yongs su bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gi nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus sngon po'i dbus su/ sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ nyon mongs pa la sogs pa bdud bzhi'i ngo bo tshangs pa ser po/ dbang po dkar po/ nye dbang sngon po/ drag po nag po rnams nyal thabs su bkram pa'i gdan dang*/ 'dab ma brgyad la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ shar du tshangs pa ser po/ lhor dbang po dkar po/ nub tu nyi dbang sngon po/ byang du drag po nag po/ byang shar du gshin rje sngon po/ shar lhor nor bdag ser po/ lho nub tu srin po nag po/ nub byang du thag bzang rigs dud kha rnams 'gyel zhing gdong gyen du phyogs pa'i gdan dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nī la ya badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/

de dag ni pho brang bskyed pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi yan lag ste dang po'o/ / dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ āḥ phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i steng du dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i bdag nyid/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha kṣa/ ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha/ phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de gnyis bar du/ hūṃ las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral bar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de'i g.yon du aṃ las gri gug sngon nag yu ba la aṃ gis mtshan pa ste de dag so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ nyi zla phyag mtshan sa bon dang bcas pa ro gcig tu 'dres pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ de las sku yongs su rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo/ bcom ldan 'das rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog dkar po/ zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar po/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dmar/ steng zhal dud kha/ zhal lhag ma gnyis gnyis gnag pa/ zhal re re la spyan dmar po gsum gsum dang ldan pa mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ mche ba'i myu gu bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ hūṃ gi sgra sgrog cing 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs par mdzad pa/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug bzung pa'i/ g.yas kyi dang po na glang po che dkar po/ g.yon gyi dang po na sa'i lha mo ser mo/ de gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na rta sngon po/ gsum pa na bong bu gwa pa/ bzhi pa na glang dmar po/ lnga pa na rnga mong thal dkar/ drug pa na skyes pa rang mdog/bdun pa na sha ra bha sngon po/

brgyad pa na byi la gwa pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na chu'i lha dkar po/ gsum pa na me'i lha dmar po/ bzhi pa na rlung gi lha ljang khu/ lnga pa na zla ba'i lha dkar po/ drug pa na nyi ma'i lha dmar po/ bdun pa na gshin rje sngon po/ brgyad pa na nor sbyin ser po/ mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sku la thal bas nye bar byugs pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ zhabs mdun ma gnyis g.yon bskum g.yas brkyang pa dang*/ rgyab ma gnyis skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bdud bzhi mnan pa/ sgeg cing dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /rgod cing drag shul 'jigs su rung*/ /snying rje ngam dang zhi ba yi/ /gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ /de'i pang na yum rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog sngon mo/ gcer bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga yi dbu brgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang g.yas bskum pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ze 'bru la āḥs mtshan pa/ oṃ padma su kha dhā ra mahā rā ga su khaṃ da da tsa tur ā nan da bha ga bi shwa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ karyaṃ ku ru ṣa me/ yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ oṃ badzra mahā dwe ṣa tsa tur ā nan da dā ya ka kha ga mu kha e ka rā so na tha hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ karyaṃ ku ru ṣa me/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba chen po'i sgras phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi padmar babs pa thig le brgyad du gyur pa rnams/

gaṃ tsaṃ baṃ ghaṃ paṃ shaṃ laṃ ḍaṃ zhes pa'i sa bon brgyad du gyur/ de rnams lha mo brgyad du gyur pa/ yum gyi mkha' nang nas phyir spros te/ gdan so so'i steng du 'khod pa ni/ shar du gau rī nag mo g.yas gri gug /g.yon nya ro hi ta 'dzin pa/ lhor tsau rī dmar mo g.yas ḍā ma ru/ g.yon phag pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu bai ta lī ser mo/ g.yas rus sbal g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ byang du ghasma rī ljang khu g.yas sbrul/ g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ byang shar du pukka sī sngon mo g.yas seng ge /g.yon dgra sta 'dzin pa/ shar lhor shā bā rī dkar mo g.yas lce spyang ngam/ dge slong*/ g.yon 'khar gsil 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu gdol pa mo sngon mo g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon thong gshol 'dzin pa/ nub byang du g.yung mo kha dog sna tshogs pa/ g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ thams cad kyang gcer bu/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ spyan gsum pa/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu rgyan cing*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yon rkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /slar yang yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas bar snang gi oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ dmar po gnyis kyi mtha' brten pa yongs su bkug /yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi padmar babs pa'i rkyen gyis/ yab yum gnyis rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu nas/ bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin gyi thig ler gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ glu'i bskul ba ni/ rje btsun snying rje'i yid bzhengs shig /pukka sī ni bdag la skyobs/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la/ /bdag la bde chen sbyor bzhed mdzod/

khyod med na ni bdag 'gum pas// kyai rdo rje khyed bzhengs shig /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la/ /ri khrod ma 'bras grub par mdzod/ /dga' gtso 'jig rten mgron gnyer ba/ /stong pa nyid la bzhugs sam ci/ khyod med phyogs ni mi 'tshal bas/ /gdol pa mo bdag zhu ba bgyid/ /g.yung mo bdag ni sems sgrim pas/ /bdag gis khyod kyi thugs 'tshal gyis/ /mig 'phrul mnga' ba khyod bzhengs shig /snying rje rgyun chad ma mdzad cig / zhes bskul bas/ thig le de nyid hūṃ dang aṃ sngon po/ 'od 'bar zhing 'jigs par gyur/ de zhu ba las bdag nyid 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs pa/ zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal mthil nag /g.yas dkar ba/ g.yon dmar ba/ steng zhal dud kha/ zhal lhag ma gnyis gnyis nag pa/ nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o 'i bar sngar bzhin bskyed/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re de rnams kyi steng du hūṃ aṃ gaṃ tsaṃ baṃ ghaṃ paṃ shāṃ laṃ ḍaṃ/ de rnams las 'od 'phros/ snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang dang*/ bcud kyi sems can lha dgu'i ngo bor gyur/ de thams cad 'od du zhu rang la thim/ mig tu maṃ las gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo/ rna bar daṃ las zhe sdang rdo rje ma sngon po/ snar paṃ las ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo/ khar rāṃ las 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ dpral bar iṃ las phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang khu/ lte ba'am snying gar naṃ las bdag med rdo rje ma nag mo/ spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje ma dkar mo/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje ma dmar mo/ thugs kar hūṃ las thugs rdo rje ma nag mo/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ gri gug dang thod pa dang kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la/

sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ oṃ e hye hi bha ga wān/ mahā kā ru ṇi ka he badzra sa pa ri wā ra/ oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod cing*/ spro na 'dir yang mchod bstod bya bsdu na mi dgos so/ / oṃ badzra gau rī a karṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ badzra tsau rī pra be shā ya hūṃ/ oṃ badzra bai ta lī ban dha baṃ/ oṃ badzra ghasma rī wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ de dag ni rjes su chags pa rdo rje sems dpa'i yan lag ste gnyis pa'o// // slar yang rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug /khro bo bcu 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ oṃ bha ga wān mahā kā ru ṇi ka he badzra pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs kyis mchod/ zhe sdang rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gti mug rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ser sna rdo rje bdag la gsol/ /'dod chags rdo rje bdag la skyobs// yid dang phrag dog chen po kun/ /rdo rje kun gyi dam tshig mchog /las rnams thams cad sgrub byed pa/ /rdo rje can kun bdag dgyes mdzod/ / ces pas bstod/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams// thugs rje'i bdag nyid can rnams kyis/ khyed kyis bdag la dbang bskur stsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ khams gsum kun kyis phyag byas pa/ /rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ /oṃ badzri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing*/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur/ rig ma rnams kyis rdo rje glu len/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ lha mo rnams kyis mchod/ dbang gi chu rgyun gyis lus thams cad gang*/

dbang bzhi thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo yab yum dang gau rī dang pukka sī la mi bskyod pa/ tsau rī dang shā bā rī la rnam par snang mdzad/ bai ta lī dang tsaṇḍa lī la rin chen 'byung ldan/ ghasma rī dang ḍombhinī la 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta badzrā swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ skabs 'dir lus dkyil gyis dbang rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dang lus dkyil dang ma 'brel ba'i dbang bzhi chu rgyun gcig ma byed par spro na ni gong ma'i gsung du lta'o/ /de dag ni dbang bskur ba mi bskyod pa'i yan lag ste gsum pa'o// // nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs/ 'bru gsum gyis myang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta swa da na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /bdud rtsi myang ba 'od dpag med kyi yan lag ste bzhi pa'o// // dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ / zhes sogs kyis mthar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badzra swa bhā ātma ko3haṃ/ / zhes brjod/ /de ni mchod pa don yod grub pa'i yan lag ste lnga pa'o// // khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor/ khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyi mchog brnyes pa/ khyod kyis rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba kun brgyan te/ /snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can sad mdzad pa/ /sgyu ma'i spros pa rdo rje bsgrub pa'i yid/ / he ru ka dpal rdo rje yid kyis dgyes/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga tāstu ti badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ bstod pa rin chen 'byung ldan gyi yan lag ste drug pa'o// // gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor la brgyad las/ dang po dag pa dran pa ni/ snying rje'i spyan ni dmar po la/ /byams pa'i thugs kyis sku lus gnag /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi yis ni/ /zhabs ni rnam par bzhi zhes brjod/

/zhal brgyad rnam par thar pa brgyad/ /phyag ni stong pa bcu drug nyid/ /gug skyed kyis ni sangs rgyas lnga/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo nyid/ /rdo rje gsum gyi dag pa'i spyan/ /gzugs phung gau rīr bshad pa ste/ / tshor ba la ni chom rkun ma/ /'du shes ro langs ma yin te/ /'du byed ghasma rī rab grags/ /rnam shes phung po'i tshul gyis ni/ /bdag med rnal 'byor ma gnas so/ /sa ni pukka sīr bshad de/ /chu khams rngon pa ma zhes brjod/ /me ni gtum mor shes par bya/ /rlung ni g.yung mor rab tu grags/ /spyi bo'i 'khor lo mi bskyod pa/ /rna cha'i bdag nyid 'od dpag med/ /mgul gyi phreng ba rin chen bdag /lag par rnam par snang mdzad brjod/ /ska rags la ni don yod gnas/ /yan lag kun la rdor 'dzin mgon/ /gzhal yas khang ni byang chub kyi phyogs chos sum cu rtsa bdun rnam par dag pa'o/ /dur khrod brgyad ni/ rnam par shes pa brgyad dag pa'o/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo ni bdud bzhi bcom pa'i ye shes so/ / zhes brjod pa'o/ /gnyis pa bzlas pa la/ bzlas bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ aṣta na nā ya/ piṃ gaurdha ka sha bart+ma ne/ tsa tur biṃ sha ti ne trā ya/ ṣo ḍa sha bhu dza ya/ kriṣṇa dzi mū ta ba pu ṣe/ ka pā la mā la a ne kaṃ dhā ri ṇi/ ātma ta gu ra tsitta ya/ ardhen du daṃṣṭhi ṇa/ oṃ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ kā ra ya kā ra ya/ gardza ya gardza ya/ tardza ya tardza ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ sabta sa ga rā na/ ban dha ban dha/ nā ga aṣta kān/ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa/ sha trun ha hā hi hī hu hū he hai ho hau haṃ haḥphaṭa swāhā/ yab kyi rtsa sngags so/ / oṃ de wa pi tsu badzra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ snying po'o/ / oṃ badzra kartā ri he badzra ye hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ / oṃ āḥ.āṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥnaṃ badzra nai rātma hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ bdag med ma'i 'o/ / oṃ āḥgaṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥtsaṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/

oṃ āḥbaṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥghaṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥpaṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥshāṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥlaṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥḍaṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ rgyas pa ni/ oṃ āḥgaṃ badzra gau rī hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /de nas skabs 'dir gtor ma mi gtong na/ gsum pa spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad dag pa'i 'khor lor gyur/ 'od du zhu bsrung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ de 'od du zhu gzhal yas khang dur khrod dang bcas pa la/ de 'od du zhu lha mo brgyad la thim/ lha mo brgyad zhal brgyad la thim/ rang gi zhal phyag lhag ma rtsa ba'i zhal phyag la thim/ de yang 'od gsal du zhugs/ cung zad mnyam par bzhag / slar yang rang nyid phyag gnyis par gyur/ mig tu gti mug rdo rje nas/ bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ 'gro ba thams cad dpal he ru ka'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du rnam par dag go/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /he ru ka dpal 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yis sa la 'khod par shog /

ces sogs/ smon lam btab ste/ spyod lam la 'jug par bya'o// //bzhi pa gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ gtor ma rnams chu chang nang mchod kyis sbyangs/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gaṃ sngon po ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du āḥlas thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ de'i nang du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ shar du go las ba glang gi sha /lhor ku las khyi'i sha /nub tu da las rta'i sha/ byang du ha las glang po che'i sha /dbus su na las mi'i sha /sha de rnams re re'i steng du/ bar du bi las dri chen/ lhor ra las rakta/ nub tu shu las byang sems/ byang du mā las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ dbus su mu las dri chu/ de rnams kyi steng du shar du bhruṃ bhruṃ me long lta bu'i ye shes/ lhor aṃ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ nub tu dzriṃ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ byang du khaṃ bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes/ dbus su hūṃ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ zla ba'i mthar g.yon bskor gyis/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ g.yas bskor gyis/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha kṣaḥ de rnams kyi steng gi nam mkha' la/ oṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du blta ba/ de'i steng du raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros/ rlung gi ba dan la phog/rlung g.yos me sbar bas/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga rnams bskol ba/ 'od du zhu ba'i rlangs pa gyen la song ba/ oṃ dang rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūṃ la phog pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzags/

yang hūṃ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rnams he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par byon nas rdo rje'i hūṃ la thim pas/ rdo rje brjid dang ldan par gyur/ rdo rje nyi ma oṃ dang bcas pa thod pa'i nang du lhung ba 'od du zhu nas/ sngar gyi bdud rtsi rnams dang gnyis su med par gyur te/ kha dog dang dri dang ro dang nus pa phun sum tshogs pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ zhes lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar e las byung ba'i chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi nang du/ paṃ paṃ paṃ las padma 'dab brgyad re re/ steng gi padma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la/ oṃ dgu yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su sku rdo rje/ shar du dbang phyug chen po/ lhor lha'i dbang po/ nub tu tshangs pa/ byang du khyab 'jug /shar lhor 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ lho nub tu tshogs kyi bdag po/ nub byang du bhring gi ṇi/ byang shar du karti ka ste/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar po/ zhal gcig pa phyag gnyis kyi 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ bar gyi padma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la/ hūṃ dgu yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar du brgya byin/ lhor gshin rje/ nub tu chu lha/ byang du gnod sbyin/ shar lhor me lha/ lho nub tu srin po/ nub byang du rlung lha/ byang shar du dbang ldan te/ thams cad kyang sku mdog sngon po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ 'og gi padma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la āḥdagu yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su gsung rdo rje/ shar du stobs kyi rgyu/ lhor dung skyong*/ nub tu mtha' yas/ byang du nor rgyas/ shar lhor 'jog po/ lho nub tu rigs ldan/

nub byang du padma/ byang shar du padma chen po ste/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar po/ padma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ 'byung po nyer bzhi po 'di dag thams cad kyang padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la g.yas brkyang pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rang 'dra'i yum gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ steng gi lha thams cad lha chen brgyad la 'dres/ sa steng na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad phyogs skyong brgyad la 'dres/ sa 'og na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad klu chen brgyad la 'dres te gnyis su med par gyur/ de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ yang rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyai rdo rje lha dgu sku gsung thugs rdo rje dang bcas pas rnam par/ oṃ e hye hi bha ga wān mahā kā ru ṇi ka he badzra sa pa ri wā ra kā ya wāka tsitta oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badzra gau rī a kar ṣā ya dzaḥ oṃ badzra tsau rī pra bai sha ya hūṃ/ oṃ badzra bai ta lī ban dha baṃ/ oṃ badzra gasma rī ba shaṃ ku ru hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid can rnams kyis/ khyod kyis 'di la dbang bskur pa stsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ khams gsum kun kyis phyag byas pa/ /rdo rje dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ /oṃ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas/ lus thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag /dbang thams cad thob/

chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ sku rdo rje lha chen brgyad dang bcas pa la rnam par snang mdzad/ gtso bo yab yum gau rī dang pukka sī la mi bskyod pa/ tsau rī dang shā wā rī la rnam par snang mdzad/ bai ta lī dang tsaṇḍa lī la rin chen 'byung ldan/ ghasma rī dang ḍoṃ bhi nī la 'od dpag med/ phyogs skyong brgyad la mi bskyod pa/ gsung rdo rje klu chen brgyad dang bcas pa la 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ zhes brjod/ oṃ bha ga wān mahā ka ru ṇi ka / zhes pa nas/ ka ya wāka tsitta/ oṃ badzra ni ri te hūṃ khaṃ swāhā/ zhes sogs kyi chu bzhi phul/ de nas pad bskor bya zhing ngag tu/ oṃ bha ga wān mahā ka ru ṇi ka he badzra sa pa ri wā ra kā ya wāka tsitta oṃ inda dza ma/ dza la/ dzakkha/ bhu da/ bahni bā u rakkha/ tsanda/ sudzdza/ mā ta/ bāspa/ ta la/ sa tā laṃ aṭṭa sarba swāhā/ zhes brjod/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye la/ i daṃ ba liṃ bhuñdza dzi gha phulla dhu pa/ maṃ sa biṃ gha ampha/ sa ba kadzdza sā dhā khanti khu ṇi phe ḍa ga da/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇaṃ a dya nurpanna twā ta/ oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum mam lnga'am bdun la sogs pas 'bul lo/ /de nas oṃ bha ga wān zhes pa nas/ kā ya wāka tsitta/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke /gandhe/ nai be tye/ shabta āḥhūṃ/ zhes pas phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes pas nang bdud rtsis mchod/ de nas dril bu bsil zhing*/ dkar mo ri dwags zhes sogs lha mo brgyad kyis kyang mchod/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma zhes sogs dang*/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ / rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod// rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/

/rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pas gos pa med/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ / mi rtog rdo rje nam mkha' 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /padma mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dngos nyid dag pa nyid las byung*/ /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ / ces pas bstod/ lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /'jig rten skyong ba brgyad po dang*/ /gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /yi dwags tshogs rnams= /sha za'i tshogs rnams= /smyo byed tshogs rnams= /brjed byed tshogs rnams= / mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams= /ma mos tshogs rnams= /de la sogs te 'byung po'i tshogs/ /ma lus ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*/ /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*/ /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun kyi stongs grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*/ /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*/ /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba dang*/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog / ces 'phrin las gzhol/ 'jig rten 'das pa dang 'jig rten pa'i gtor chog gzhan byed na'ang skabs 'dir byed par 'dod do/ /de nas dril bu rgyun dkrol dang bcas te/ kolla i ri ḍa ṭhi a bo la/ mummu ṇi re kakko la/

gha ṇe kri pi ṭa ho badzdza i/ ka ru ṇe ka a i ṇa ro lā/ ta hiṃ ba la/ khadzdza ī/ gā ḍeṃ ma a ṇa bi dza a i/ ha la ka liñdza ra ga ṇi a i/ duu dhu ra badzdzi a i/ tsa u sa ma katstshu ri sihla/ ka pu ra la i a i/ ma la indha ṇa sā liṃ dza/ ta hiṃ bha ru kha i a i/ phraiṃ kha ṇa kha ṭa ka rante/ shud dha a shud dha ṇa ma ṇi a i/ ni raṃ su aṃ ga tsa ḍa wi/ ta hiṃ dza sa ra wa pa ṇi a i/ ma la a tse kun dhu ru bā ḍa i/ ḍiṇḍaṃ ma ta hi ṇṇa badzdzi a i/ zhes rdo rje'i glu blangs/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ / sangs rgyas padmo rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang po yin/ /de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba// 'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i gnyis pa yin/ /dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyis mchod pa'i gnas/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa yin/ / zhes sogs bkra shis brjod/ rigs su skyes dang dam tshig can/ /smyon med kyai rdo rje ston/ /bla ma la gus snying rjer ldan/ /skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'khrol/ /zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang*/ /btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zas can/ /skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par/ /gang gi lam gyis grol gyur pa/ /de yis sangs rgyas myur thob shog / ces smon lam btab bo/ /de nas yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod/ nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ āḥhūṃ badzra muḥ gtor ma'i mgron gyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ

rang la gnyis su med par thim/ zhes brjod do/ /lnga pa kha zas kyi rnal 'byor dang*/ drug pa nyal ba'i rnal 'byor dang*/ bdun pa ldang ba'i rnal 'byor dang*/ brgyad pa khrus kyi rnal 'byor rnams phal cher spyi dang 'dra'o/ /yang sgrub 'bras yan lag bzhi pa maṇḍal mchod chog dang bcas pa shes par 'dod na ni/ slob dpon rtse mo dang 'phags pa'i gsung las shes par bya la/ 'di dag gi rgyab brten du mi thub zla ba dang*/ mtsho skyes kyi gzhung la'ang bslab par bya'o/ /'di brtsams dge ba gang yod pa/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i don du bsngo/ /de las nam mkha'i mthas klas par/ /bde chen bla na med pa thob/ /ces pa 'di yang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas gzhan 'ga' la phan pa'i don du sbyar ba'o/ /dge legs 'phel/ maṅga laṃ// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/dpal kyai rdo rje'i sgrub thabs gong ma'i gsung gi rjes 'brang bzhugs/ - PAGE 82 -- PAGE 81 -- PAGE 58 -
